cards.title: Scaffold: project root, vendored repos, venv, config store
cards.description: F:/aaaaaVIBECODING/Kinesis created. whitehatboy005/Virtual-Mouse and xinghaochen/awesome-hand-pose-estimation cloned into vendor/. The earlier fixed build preserved in reference/legacy/. kinesis/config.py holds defaults + the calibration store. Monitor enumeration via EnumDisplayMonitors indexes the 4 displays left-to-right.

cards.title: Latency and jitter: snap cursor, One-Euro filter, deadband
cards.description: Capture thread keeps only the newest frame (BUFFERSIZE=1); inference thread drops stale frames. One-Euro filter on all 21 landmark axes (min_cutoff 1.6, beta 0.05) plus a deadband so a still hand gives a still cursor. Cursor written with SetCursorPos via ctypes, no pyautogui, no easing. Measured end-to-end 45-48 ms average, 81-104 ms peak, camera-limited at 15 fps.

cards.title: Pose engine: joint-angle fingers, poses, pointing angles
cards.description: Finger states from the PIP joint angle with hysteresis (>155 extended, <110 curled) so a rotated hand still reads correctly - the property upstream lacked. Scale-relative pinch thresholds (wrist to middle knuckle). Poses OPEN/FIST/SHAKA/POINT/PINCH_x/MIXED. Pointing yaw/pitch from MediaPipe metric world landmarks with a consistent 2D fallback. Rotation invariance verified at 0/45/90/135/-90 degrees.

cards.title: Aim: calibration wizard + monitor classifier
cards.description: calibrate.py samples pointing angles per monitor for 2 s each, saves kinesis_calibration.json, and reports whether the angles are monotonic left-to-right. Classifier = nearest centroid in yaw/pitch with 7 deg hysteresis and a 42 deg distance gate; heuristic virtual-desktop mapping before calibration. Tested against the real 4-monitor layout.

cards.title: Gestures: all eleven, with conflict arbitration
cards.description: Eleven gestures implemented as an explicit state machine emitting Intent objects (no Windows calls in the engine). Includes the click-vs-close-flick arbitration (pinch arms a click, a fist inside the 120 ms release grace cancels it), single held-action lock, swipe cooldown, and the two-handed Alt-Tab flow.

cards.title: Actions: aimed window targeting, fullscreen-aware minimise, Alt-Tab, PTT
cards.description: Topmost non-blocklisted window on the aimed monitor is the target. Fullscreen detected by rect-equals-monitor + not maximised; minimise exits fullscreen first via a deferred queue so the tracking loop never blocks. YouTube detection by window title picks f vs F11. Shift+cursor lock in browsers, no frozen cursor during drag.

cards.title: HUD + safety: release-all, dry run, END key
cards.description: Preview overlay shows pose, aim + confidence, active action, yaw/pitch, fps and end-to-end latency. release_all covers drag/Alt/Ctrl+Space and runs on hand loss, exit, exception and END. --dry logs every action without injecting; --exclusive limits to cursor movement only.

cards.title: Tests: 53 deterministic checks, no camera needed
cards.description: Synthetic landmark geometry with exact joint angles drives the real PoseDetector and GestureEngine. Covers every gesture, the conflict rules, hysteresis/cooldowns, aim classification, the One-Euro filter, wheel accumulation, deadband and release-all. 53 passed.

cards.title: Joe: calibrate aim at the desk and report feel
cards.description: Needs hands on: run calibrate.bat pointing at each of the 4 displays, then run.bat. Report pinch tightness, filter smoothness, swipe threshold and flick timing. Every threshold is exposed via --tune so tuning is numbers, not guesswork.

cards.title: Tune gesture thresholds from live use
cards.description: Adjust pinch_on/off, filter_min_cutoff, filter_beta, deadband_px, flick_window_s, swipe_min_fraction, scroll_gain, alt_tab_hold_s based on what Joe reports, then --save-config.

cards.title: Publish to GitHub as DrGekoz/Kinesis
cards.description: Local git repo initialised and committed. Pushing to GitHub is deliberately left as an explicit request - vendor/ submodules and cast/ref assets excluded, .venv ignored.

cards.title: Upgrade path: better 3D hand pose for aiming accuracy
cards.description: If aiming accuracy is not enough with MediaPipe, the curated list points at HAPTIX (CVPR 2024, reconstructing hands in 3D with transformers) or HaMuCo (ICCV 2023) for pose quality, Deformer (ICCV 2023) for temporal jitter fusion, and FastHand/MobRecon if speed is the constraint. A custom gesture classifier would train on RHD (41k synthetic, free labels) or FreiHAND.

cards.title: P12 - Gaze-driven scrolling
cards.description: GazeScroller in gestures.py: hold your gaze in the top or bottom 12% band and it scrolls while you keep looking. Dwell before engaging (a glance is not a scroll), ramp to full speed, cooldown after release, immediate stop when the gaze leaves the band, stale-gaze rejection. The wheel goes to the window under the cursor, so it warps the cursor onto the gaze point first (gaze_scroll_warp_cursor).

cards.title: Gaze calibration with Joe's eyes
cards.description: Run calibrate_gaze.bat and check the reported monitor hit rate (target 85%+). Re-run with --points 9 if it is low. Needs Joe at the desk - cannot be verified from the agent side.

cards.title: Tune against live feel
cards.description: After real use: pinch_on at his seated distance, Alt-Tab 2s delay, swipe_min_fraction for tab swipes, gaze scroll speed/band. All exposed via --tune / kinesis_config.json.
